title: Cyber Sorceress Eclipse
description: A hooded female sorceress with purple hair and glowing blue accents stands at a stone altar in a dark gothic cyberpunk ruin, holding a glowing orb above an ornate golden incense burner. Below her, a massive red and black eclipse looms over a neon-lit digital cityscape while black birds fly through a swirling cosmic sky filled with purple nebulae and green circuit patterns.
prompt: A mysterious hooded sorceress with long purple hair wearing metallic armor and flowing robes stands at an ancient stone altar, performing a ritual with a glowing blue orb above a golden censer emitting smoke. She is surrounded by black ravens, skeletal hands emerging from fog, and glowing golden runes. In the background a giant red and black solar eclipse dominates a swirling cosmic sky with purple nebulae and green circuit patterns, overlooking a cyberpunk city with neon lights, all in a dark gothic digital fantasy style.
